---
title: "Programming Languages"
---

Programming language concepts, runtime behaviour, type systems, and practical examples.

## Topics

- [Java](java.qmd) — Start with [JVM Topics](java/jvm/index.qmd), including the [Java Memory Model (JMM)](java/jvm/jmm/index.qmd).
- [Rust](rust.qmd) — Ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, and fearless concurrency.
- [Go (Golang)](go.qmd) — Goroutines, channels, interfaces, and concurrent services.
- [TypeScript](typescript.qmd) — Structural typing, generics, inference, and application architecture.
- [JavaScript](javascript.qmd) — Closures, the event loop, promises, and the language runtime.
- [Python](python.qmd) — The object model, iterators, typing, concurrency, and scientific computing.
- [C#](csharp.qmd) — The type system, async/await, LINQ, memory, and runtime behaviour.
- [Prolog](prolog.qmd) — Unification, logical inference, backtracking, and declarative programming.

Each topic will grow into a collection of worked examples, conceptual explanations, and interactive experiments.
